items.title: Fix the revenue reporting definition
items.detail: Label every revenue figure as gross (all statuses) or completed-only — the gap is 41.6% of gross.

items.title: Launch retention program for Champions & At-Risk High Value
items.detail: These segments are under 25% of customers but a disproportionate share of lifetime value.

items.title: Reconcile legacy CRM and 2024 catalog against live systems
items.detail: 57 products and marketing_segment values are currently unusable for targeting live customers.

items.title: Add city capture to checkout/signup
items.detail: 63 customers (2.52%) can't be included in regional marketing until city is captured.

items.title: Add a rating validity constraint
items.detail: Enforce rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5 at the database layer — 41 invalid ratings found this cycle.

items.title: Retire star rating as a loyalty proxy
items.detail: Correlation with repeat purchase is r=0.03 — use RFM/order history instead.

items.title: Standardize the order-item duplicate check
items.detail: An all-column check will always report 0 duplicates since order_item_id is a unique PK — actively misleading.

items.title: Treat the forecast as a range, not a point
items.detail: Use the 95% range ($428K–$678K) for planning, not the single point estimate.
